designSystem.name: Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church (MOSC) Design System
designSystem.description: Sacred, reverent design system inspired by Orthodox Christian traditions with warm earth tones, elegant typography, and thoughtful spacing. This design system provides comprehensive guidelines for creating consistent, spiritually-inspired UI components that honor the ancient traditions of the Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church.

designPhilosophy.corePrinciple: Sacred and reverent design that reflects Orthodox Christian traditions
designPhilosophy.aesthetic: Warm earth tones, elegant typography, thoughtful spacing, and Byzantine-inspired ornamental elements
designPhilosophy.emotionalTone: Reverent, contemplative, welcoming, and spiritually grounded
designPhilosophy.culturalContext: Honors the ancient traditions of the Saint Thomas Christian community established in 52 AD

reverence.description: Design should reflect reverence and respect for Orthodox Christian traditions
reverence.manifestation: Warm colors, elegant typography, thoughtful spacing, ornamental elements

clarity.description: Information should be clear and easily accessible
clarity.manifestation: Clear typography hierarchy, consistent spacing, logical information architecture

accessibility.description: Design must be accessible to all users
accessibility.manifestation: WCAG AA compliance, semantic HTML, proper ARIA labels, visible focus states

consistency.description: Design elements should be used consistently throughout
consistency.manifestation: Standardized components, consistent color usage, uniform spacing

tradition.description: Design honors ancient traditions while being modern
tradition.manifestation: Byzantine-inspired ornaments, traditional color palette, elegant serif typography

welcome.description: Design should feel welcoming and inclusive
welcome.manifestation: Warm color tones, friendly typography, approachable layouts

cssClasses.description: Use Tailwind utility classes with custom CSS for complex patterns

componentStructure.description: Components should follow consistent structure patterns

responsiveDesign.breakpoints: Use Tailwind breakpoints: sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px), xl (1280px)
responsiveDesign.grids: Always provide mobile fallback with grid-cols-1

colorUsage.rule: Always use semantic color classes (bg-primary, text-foreground, etc.)
colorUsage.avoid: Never use hardcoded colors (bg-gray-100, text-black, etc.)
colorUsage.gradients: Use predefined gradient patterns for backgrounds

typographyUsage.rule: Always use appropriate font families for content type

spacingUsage.sections: py-16 for large, py-12 for medium, py-8 for small
spacingUsage.containers: px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 for responsive padding
spacingUsage.components: p-6 for standard cards, p-8 for large cards

aiInstructions.description: Instructions for AI to replicate this design system
aiInstructions.colorSystem: Always use the semantic color classes (bg-primary, text-foreground, bg-card, etc.) defined in the color system. Never use hardcoded colors like bg-gray-100 or text-black.
aiInstructions.typography: Use font-heading for all headings (h1-h6), font-body for paragraphs, font-caption for small text and labels. Never mix font families inappropriately.
aiInstructions.spacing: Use py-16 for major sections, py-12 for secondary sections, py-8 for compact sections. Use px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 for responsive container padding.
aiInstructions.components: Follow the component structure patterns defined in the components section. Always include proper accessibility attributes (aria-label, aria-current, etc.).
aiInstructions.shadows: Use sacred-shadow for standard cards, sacred-shadow-lg for prominent elements. Never use generic shadow-lg or shadow-md.
aiInstructions.transitions: Use reverent-transition for all interactive elements. Use reverent-hover for subtle hover scale effects.
aiInstructions.gradients: Use bg-gradient-to-br from-background to-muted for hero sections. Use the gallery container pattern for media grids.
aiInstructions.ornamentalElements: Include ornamental dividers in headers and section separators. Use the Orthodox cross and geometric patterns for decorative accents.
aiInstructions.responsiveDesign: Always design mobile-first. Use grid-cols-1 for mobile, then add responsive breakpoints (md:grid-cols-2, lg:grid-cols-3, etc.).
aiInstructions.accessibility: Always include proper ARIA labels, semantic HTML, and visible focus states. Ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA standards.
